name: troparcel
description: Collaboration for Tropy: share notes, tags, metadata, selections, transcriptions and lists with your team, through a Troparcel server or a shared folder. Photos stay on each computer.
author: Micah

scripts.pack: node esbuild.config.mjs && zip -r troparcel.zip package.json index.js icon.svg

options.label: Connection
options.hint: The invite from your group: a troparcel:// link, or the path of a folder you all sync. Or leave it empty, choose File › Export with this entry, and set Troparcel up in your browser.

options.label: Your name
options.hint: Others see your work under this name. Choose one nobody else in the group uses.

options.label: When to sync
options.hint: auto (recommended): share and receive as you work. review: share as you work; receive when you choose File › Import with this entry. push: share only. pull: receive only, when you import.

options.label: Share what I delete
options.hint: Notes, selections and transcriptions you wrote and then delete are removed for everyone else; your notes show crossed out. Tags and list memberships you remove are removed for everyone too.

options.label: Share lists
options.hint: Your lists, and which items are in them, are shared with the group.

options.label: Share photo and selection metadata
options.hint: Metadata on photos and selections is shared too, not only on items.

options.label: Publish as IIIF to
options.hint: A folder. With this set, File › Export with this entry writes IIIF manifests and images there, and shares nothing. Use a second Troparcel entry for publishing.

options.label: IIIF web address
options.hint: Where that folder will be on the web, such as https://example.edu/letters.

options.label: Detailed log
options.hint: Write each sync step to Tropy’s log (Help › Show Log Files), to help report a problem.
